builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-21, for the boys basketball build: Prep Hoops' and Prep Redzone's commitment lists and player pages, On3/Rivals class rankings, Prep Baseball Report's California list, 304 college men's basketball news feeds, school athletics sites and student and local papers, and the players' own recruiting pages. Every quote was re-read at assembly on 2026-11-21.
notes: Players on the 58 boys basketball rosters MaxPreps lists so far whom a public page says have committed to, or signed with, a college team, in basketball or any other sport. The rules are field hockey's (README, "College commitments"): the page names the player, the college and the sport, and either names his high school or gives the roster's class year with a hometown in the school's own area; offers, interests, visits and camps are not commitments; a social-media post counts only from an official college, school or club account (none is cited here).

5 commitments. Emmanuel Ahamefule (Archbishop Riordan) signed with Oregon State: its release of 2026-11-12 names him with his school. Adrian Barnett (The King's Academy) committed to Washington State football (On3/Rivals and the Spokesman-Review). Three rest on pages that put the player a class above the grade MaxPreps' 2026-27 roster still shows, which is last season's (each row carries a grade conflict in data/basketball/rosters-enrichment.json): Rocco Smith (Palo Alto, Linfield, Prep Hoops' page and commitments list), Jace Cannon (Serra, USC football, On3/Rivals and Cal-Hi Sports) and Brady Clugage (Archbishop Mitty, Chapman, medium: one row of Prep Hoops' commitments list).

Recall is partial. The signing period had just opened; Prep Hoops' article bodies and On3's NorCal pages are paywalled; 247Sports, VerbalCommits and Perfect Game refuse automated reads or draw their pages by script; most seniors and every junior were not searched name by name, and the community colleges' sites were not read. Wyatt Vonblanco (Serra), whose Prep Hoops page says Cal State San Marcos, is not listed: the page puts him in the class of 2026, a class above a roster grade 12.

Chapman's own Sidearm site metadata: schoolAttributes Division 'DIII', Conference 'SCIAC'; schedule rows give 'Southern California Intercollegiate Athletic Conference'.
